pipeline.modality: Drug-device combination — subcutaneous NanoPortal implant delivering semaglutide (GLP-1 receptor agonist)

indications.trial_name: LIBERATE-2 (Safety, Tolerability and PK of a Subcutaneous Semaglutide Implant)
indications.trial_design: First-in-human, randomized, open-label safety/tolerability/PK study of NPM-139 vs. weekly subcutaneous semaglutide (Wegovy) in adults with overweight/obesity; conducted in Australia with Avance Clinical.
indications.trial_status: Not yet recruiting (start April 2026; primary completion August 2026)

excluded_preclinical: NPM-133 — six-month semaglutide implant for type 2 diabetes (preclinical)
NPM-115 — six-month exenatide implant for obesity (preclinical / platform validation; LIBERATE-1 Phase 1 completed and program superseded by NPM-139)
OKV-119 — exenatide implant for feline/canine obesity (preclinical; partnered with Okava Pharmaceuticals)
Cortigent / Orion neurostimulation device program (early development; spun-out medical device platform — non-drug)
excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT05670379 — LIBERATE-1, Phase 1 first-in-human exenatide implant (NPM-115/NPM-119), completed 2025-08; program not advancing to later phases as company has prioritized NPM-139 semaglutide implant.
